data.one_liner: A modal progress indicator widget with Sound Null Safety.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a child widget, such as a form, and displays a modal progress HUD (Heads Up Display) overlay when an asynchronous operation is running.
use_when: You need to block user interaction and show a loading indicator during async tasks like form submission.
You want a simple widget wrapper for loading states with support for sound null safety.
avoid_when: You need complex state management architectures to handle global loading states.
You prefer route-based loading screens instead of local widget overlays.
strengths: Provides an easy-to-use widget wrapper for loading indicators.
Supports customizable properties like opacity, color, blur, and dismissibility.
weaknesses: Relies on local state variables within widgets to toggle visibility.
Limited to basic modal HUD functionality.
